key.name: edge
key.description: Which screen edge the activity tiles dock to.

key.name: offset-x
key.description: Horizontal distance from the screen edge in pixels.

key.name: offset-y
key.description: Distance from the top of the work area in pixels.

key.name: icon-size
key.description: Size of each tile in pixels.

key.name: spacing
key.description: Gap between tiles in pixels.

key.name: animate-working
key.description: Animate the tile while an agent is working.

key.name: notify-completed
key.description: Show a notification when a turn completes.

key.name: notify-approval
key.description: Show a notification when an agent waits for approval.

key.name: notify-error
key.description: Show a notification when an agent reports an error.

key.name: notify-terminated
key.description: Show a notification when an agent session terminates.

key.name: min-turn-seconds
key.description: Completion notification only for turns at least this many seconds long.

key.name: completed-hold-seconds
key.description: How long a completed or error state stays before reverting to idle.

key.name: show-prompt-text
key.description: Show prompt previews in the activity preview. Disable for privacy.

key.name: terminal-command
key.description: Command used to open a terminal. %d is replaced by the session directory.

key.name: show-on
key.description: desktop: on the desktop layer of the current workspace, hidden where an application window covers them. always: on top of every application.

key.name: hide-idle
key.description: Show a tile only while a session is working, waiting, recently completed or failed.

key.name: tile-positions
key.description: JSON object mapping provider id to its dragged position, for example {"claude-code": {"x": 1600, "y": 320}}.

key.name: panel-indicators
key.summary: Show icons in the top bar
key.description: Icons after the workspace indicator, visible from every window.

key.name: desktop-tiles
key.description: Draggable tiles on the desktop layer, hidden under application windows.

key.name: panel-placement
key.description: JSON object mapping provider id to {"box": "left"|"center"|"right", "index": n}, set by dragging.

key.name: desktop-play
key.description: When no application window is open on the workspace, desktop tiles drift around, bounce off each other and say hi.
